menus.note:
NOTE(s): 
* Key Animation and 2nd Key Animation are credited under only 原画 (Key Animation) in the credits. 
* Storyboard and Episode Director (絵コンテ・演出) are just credited as Episode Director (演出). For my sanity, I will just credit as 絵コンテ・演出.
* The crediting system for the show early on is inconsistent. For episodes 14-20, 22-25, 27-35, specifically from Key Animation to Digital Coloring, the credits are organized vertically, sometimes they're normal but often times both vertical/horizontal crediting can happen ON THE SAME PAGE.

The only info missing are the directors/storyboard artists for the OP's and ED's.
